node.title: Re^2: passing newline in string argument
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But what if someone actually wants to provide the two characters \n?

[Special_K], just for completeness, here's one common way - however, as we both [id://11165917|said], this is only a workaround with its own caveats, and the problem should be fixed in the shell instead!

sub interpolate_nl { my $str = shift; $str =~ s/(?9; is interpolate_nl("a\\b"), "a\\b"; # * is interpolate_nl("a\\nb"), "a\nb"; is interpolate_nl("a\\\\b"), "a\\b"; is interpolate_nl("a\\\\nb"), "a\\nb"; is interpolate_nl("a\\\\\\b"), "a\\\\b"; # * is interpolate_nl("a\\\\\\nb"), "a\\\nb"; is interpolate_nl("a\\\\\\\\b"), "a\\\\b"; is interpolate_nl("a\\\\\\\\nb"), "a\\\\nb"; is interpolate_nl("a\\\\\\\\\\nb"), "a\\\\\nb"; # * \b and all other escapes are unhandled and ignored!

(Bonus: even more rope to shoot yourself in the foot: [mod://String::Unescape])
